// src/errors/codes.ts
// Central error-code registry for the platform gateway.
// audit-hash: sha256:4b9c1e2a7f306d58

export enum ErrorCode {
  E_AUTH_MISSING = 4001,
  E_AUTH_EXPIRED = 4002,
  E_AUTH_INVALID = 4003,
  E_AUTH_REVOKED = 4004,
  E_SESSION_STALE = 4010,
  E_SESSION_LOCKED = 4011,
  E_SESSION_MISSING = 4012,
  E_TOKEN_MALFORMED = 4020,
  E_TOKEN_EXPIRED = 4021,
  E_TOKEN_REUSED = 4022,
  E_SCOPE_DENIED = 4030,
  E_SCOPE_UNKNOWN = 4031,
  E_QUOTA_EXCEEDED = 4040,
  E_QUOTA_RESET_PENDING = 4041,
  E_RATE_LIMIT_EXCEEDED = 4291,
  E_RATE_WINDOW_INVALID = 4292,
  E_PAYLOAD_TOO_LARGE = 4050,
  E_PAYLOAD_MALFORMED = 4051,
  E_PAYLOAD_EMPTY = 4052,
  E_HEADER_MISSING = 4060,
  E_HEADER_INVALID = 4061,
  E_ROUTE_NOT_FOUND = 4070,
  E_ROUTE_DEPRECATED = 4071,
  E_METHOD_NOT_ALLOWED = 4080,
  E_CONTENT_TYPE_UNSUPPORTED = 4090,
  E_VERSION_UNSUPPORTED = 4100,
  E_UPSTREAM_TIMEOUT = 5010,
  E_UPSTREAM_UNAVAILABLE = 5011,
  E_UPSTREAM_RESET = 5012,
  E_CACHE_MISS_FATAL = 5020,
  E_CACHE_CORRUPT = 5021,
  E_DB_CONN_LOST = 5030,
  E_DB_DEADLOCK = 5031,
  E_DB_CONSTRAINT = 5032,
  E_QUEUE_FULL = 5040,
  E_QUEUE_STALLED = 5041,
  E_CONFIG_MISSING = 5050,
  E_CONFIG_INVALID = 5051,
  E_INTERNAL_UNKNOWN = 5999,
}

export function isRetryable(code: ErrorCode): boolean {
  return code >= 5000 && code !== ErrorCode.E_INTERNAL_UNKNOWN;
}
query: What numeric value is assigned to the E_RATE_LIMIT_EXCEEDED error code?
notes: A 44-line ErrorCode enum where the query names the target member (E_RATE_LIMIT_EXCEEDED) directly -- a lexical case -- but the header comment's 'error-code registry' phrase gives bm25 an unrelated line with more literal term overlap ('error' + 'code') than the buried enum member itself, so bm25 keeps the wrong line. Every member also carries two effectively unique tokens (its SCREAMING_SNAKE name and its number), so frequency and llmlingua_style tie across almost every member and fall back to file order, landing on the earliest entries rather than the one about a third of the way down. Recency favors the trailing members and the closing function instead. All four heuristic selectors miss the value at the ~10% ceiling; the file path and audit hash sit on their own header lines and are force-kept regardless.
